Thanks — quick pricing sketch based on the numbers and the sample CSV. High-level summary below; I'll put the detailed table in the attached PDF and the banded CSV for the call.

Assumptions:
- Avg tokens/request: 300
- Cacheable fraction: 30%
- Heavy model tokens cost multiplier: 2.1x
- Baseline latency SLO for pinned endpoints: 200 ms p50, 600 ms p95

Proposed hosted bands (per 1M tokens, USD)
- 0–10M: $820 / 1M (entry, no burst guaranteed)
- 10–30M: $640 / 1M (recommended baseline for Crescent central scenario)
- 30–60M: $560 / 1M (volume discount, requires 30-day commit review)
- 60M+: custom pricing (negotiated, expect <= $480 / 1M with stronger commit)

Burst overlay (ephemeral TPS headroom during 30-min window): $0.06 per ephemeral token-equivalent minute (billed against peak minutes used). Example: 150 TPS sustained for 30 minutes ~ ~27M token-equivalent-minute — pricing shown in table.

Target commercial message to Crescent: using the central scenario (25M/month) and expected cache behavior, effective unit price ~ $630 / 1M tokens (weighted mix of models and caching). This maps to an estimated $15.7k / month spend.
